scopeNote: Covers building permits and 311 code-enforcement service requests within the City of San Antonio. Bexar County and surrounding municipalities keep their own records.

violations.coverage: San Antonio 311 service requests routed to Code Enforcement Services (overgrown yard, junk vehicle, dangerous premise, zoning, graffiti and similar), live feed current to 2026. These are complaint-driven service requests, not formal citations; the city publishes no standalone violations dataset.

permits.coverage: San Antonio permits issued January 2025 to present.

source.name: City of San Antonio Open Data
source.currentRecordsNote: Permits are published by the Development Services Department; 311 code cases come from the city's 311 All Service Calls layer on the COSAGIS open-data hub.
